title: Soul Feast #37: Together Miniseries #7: Where We’re Going
excerpt: In this Soul Feast of the Together miniseries, Gary brings the spiritual journey full circle by exploring where we’re going as individuals and as a species.
bodyHtml:
In this Soul Feast of the Together miniseries, Gary brings the spiritual journey full circle by exploring where we’re going as individuals and as a species.

A profound shift in consciousness is underway, moving humanity from fear-driven external power to love-based authentic power.

Gary reflects on the arc of human evolution and explains why this transformation – already unfolding – is the most significant shift our species has ever faced.

Gary contrasts the old world, defined by five-sensory perception and fear, with the new, multisensory world rooted in the soul. Drawing on examples from history and personal awareness, he reveals how this shift is not just philosophical – it’s personal.

We are living at the tipping point between two vastly different paradigms, and each of us must choose where to stand: in the past of manipulation and control, or in the present of emotional awareness and soul-alignment.

Authentic power – rooted in love, patience, and reverence for life – is the destination. The path begins in you.

As Gary emphasizes, this journey isn’t abstract or someday—it’s here and now. We are all standing in the great divide between fear and love. Which will you choose?

Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:02) – Why both the old and new worlds are calling you – and how to recognize the difference
(02:52) – How external power lost its purpose and why the new consciousness is emerging
(06:12) – What authentic power really is – and how it transforms your inner world
(09:03) – The two inner journeys: one into fear, one into love – and the outcomes of each
(11:58) – Why the new consciousness is no longer visionary, but real and here
(15:01) – What history’s most brutal leaders reveal about the old consciousness
(18:05) – The great divide: why your soul’s evolution depends on which side you choose

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:
This week, Gary invites you to tune into resonance. Take out your soul notebook and write down anything from this episode that stirred something inside you – not just what you thought about, but what you felt. What made your inner strings vibrate? These are the messages your soul wants you to remember. Return to them throughout the week and notice what emerges. What speaks to your soul today may guide you into your most aligned tomorrow.

Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give. Enroll in Soul Themes Today. Your soul has been waiting for you to take this journey!
